subject: math
description: Calculate the volume of cylinders from radius or diameter and height, using appropriate pi approximations and correct cubic units.
learningObjectives: Identify the radius, diameter, and height needed to find cylinder volume
Use the formula V = pi r squared h to calculate cylinder volume
Convert diameter to radius before substituting into the volume formula
Use pi approximations such as 3.14 or 22/7 when appropriate
Label cylinder volume answers with correct cubic units
